instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: All right, put the blue block oriented this way across the bottom two squares of your little grid. And then on the bottom right-hand little bit here, put your two red blocks, one on top of the other. So you should see sort of a backwards L shape.

assumptions: The blue block's 'this way' orientation is axis=x (default for blue).
The red blocks are upright (axis=y) by default.
The 'bottom two squares' refers to the front row (z=[2,4]).
The 'bottom right-hand little bit here' refers to the front-right cell (x=[2,4], z=[2,4]).
evidence: put the blue block oriented this way across the bottom two squares of your little grid
on the bottom right-hand little bit here, put your two red blocks, one on top of the other
So you should see sort of a backwards L shape
